metadata.name: Kythoria Continental Map
metadata.coordinate_system: C-1,R-1 = top-left (northwest). Column increases eastward, Row increases southward.
metadata.notes: Draft for review. Underdark/cave systems omitted from surface map except where noted.

Capital_C3.description: Seat of a capital, major population center

Large_C2.description: Major ruined city, large port, fortress settlement

Small_C1.description: Frontier town, village, minor settlement, outpost

POI_P1.description: Single building, ruin, landmark, cavern entrance, glacier

Region.description: Forest, mountain range, sea, contested zone

mountain_ranges.name: Spine of the World

segments.note: Divides NW monster-held from NE Frostmaw
Southern foothills, separates Frostmaw from Kazadur region

mountain_ranges.description: Massive mountain range. Rich in iron and unrefined crystal. Narrow passes guarded by Skallfang patrols. No monster army has crossed in force.

rivers.name: Frostmaw River
rivers.description: Flows from Spine of the World through Frostwood lowlands to Icefang Sea. Lifeblood of the Frostmaw.

rivers.name: Elyndor River Confluence
rivers.description: Two rivers converge at Elyndor. Exact tributary paths TBD when map detail increases.

rivers_placeholder.name: Heartlands River System
rivers_placeholder.note: Central river system feeding Hearthglen valley and surrounding farmlands. Tributaries from Spine of the World southward through the heartlands. Exact paths TBD.

seas.name: Icefang Sea
seas.description: Northern ocean. Perpetually choked with ice floes. Few ships venture here.

forests.name: The Frostwood
forests.description: Stunted, frozen forest of twisted pines and hardy shrubs in Frostmaw river valleys. Only source of timber in the region.

forests.name: The Verdant Reaches
forests.description: Vast old-growth forest. Part of former Kingdom of Elyndor territory. Dense canopy — some areas never see sunlight.

forests.name: The Underdark (Surface Forest)
forests.description: Forest of perpetual shadow. Colossal Black Willow at center blocks all sunlight. Drow theocratic community. South-west Kythoria. Besieged but never breached during invasion.

roads.name: The Frontier Road
roads.description: Extends west from heartlands into contested territory. Lifeline for military supply convoys. Always guarded.

locations.name: Skywatch
locations.terrain: Elevated terrain with panoramic views. Highest of the three capitals.
locations.rationale: Primary scouting/observation hub. Ruled by King + Council of Eyes. Elven capital city. Northernmost of the three capitals.

locations.name: Weaveheart
locations.terrain: Atop a ley line convergence. Arcane energy flows close to surface.
locations.rationale: Arcane/research heart. Magical barrier powered from here. Human capital city. South of Skywatch.

locations.name: Emberforge
locations.terrain: Beneath a volcanic ash wasteland (surface is barren). Underground city harnessing geothermal activity.
locations.rationale: Industrial heart. Dwarven capital city. West of Skywatch and Weaveheart.

locations.name: Arcane-Reactive Crystal Cave
locations.terrain: Underground — not visible on surface map
locations.rationale: Stretches beneath Skywatch and Weaveheart, beside Emberforge. Massive crystal formations of condensed B essence. Supercharges soil fertility above. Full extent unknown.
locations.surface_only_note: NOT rendered on surface map — listed here as context for why capitals are placed here.

locations.name: Drakhaven
locations.terrain: Center of the continent. Where all trade routes converged. Wide paved avenues, grand architecture.
locations.rationale: Largest pre-invasion city. Human kingdom capital. Partially reclaimed. Trade routes converge here. Self-styled 'capital of Kythoria'.

locations.name: Hearthglen
locations.terrain: Fertile river valley. Agricultural land — now ruined and salted.
locations.rationale: Halfling kingdom capital. Central position for trade. West of Kazadur, somewhat east of Drakhaven. Trade partner with Kazadur (metals → minting). Royal Mint location.

locations.name: Everquill
locations.terrain: City of pale towers. Central position among kingdoms for diplomacy. Wide boulevards, terraced gardens.
locations.rationale: Gnome kingdom capital. Centrally positioned among the six mortal kingdoms. Between Drakhaven and the frontier transition. Paper capital — treaties, laws, maps penned here.

locations.name: Elyndor
locations.terrain: Frested region at confluence of two rivers. Elegant ruins woven into living trees.
locations.rationale: Elven kingdom capital. Southeast of heartlands. Verdant Reaches in its territory. Sacred grove at city center. Still monster-held, unreclaimed.

locations.name: Kazadur
locations.terrain: Carved into mountain range (Spine of the World foothills). Grew inward and downward following ore veins. Terraced mining above ground.
locations.rationale: Dwarven kingdom capital. Northeast of Kythoria. Rich in iron, silver, gold, platinum, gemstones. Deepest halls sealed — undiscovered.

locations.name: Logistics Hub
locations.terrain: Fortified waystation. Halflings coordinate shipping of raw materials from mines.
locations.rationale: Halfling-run shipping coordinator between Kazadur mines and Hearthglen mint. Minor settlement.

locations.name: Metal Mining Town
locations.terrain: Focused on extracting currency metals (gold, silver, copper, platinum).
locations.rationale: One of three minor settlements in the Kazadur mining cluster. Open to any race wanting to earn coin.

locations.name: Gemstone Mining Town
locations.terrain: Focused on extracting gemstones.
locations.rationale: One of three minor settlements in the Kazadur mining cluster. Open to any race wanting to earn coin.

locations.name: Stonefist
locations.terrain: Massive unadorned stone carved from living rock. Fortress capital. Training grounds cut into mountainside.
locations.rationale: Half-Orc kingdom capital. Rugged, defensible mountain region. Exact position lore says 'TBD' — placed west of Kazadur in a mountainous zone that fits the defensive fortress description. Monster-held.

locations.name: Stoefall
locations.terrain: Edge of Last Stand territory. Timber and stone. Half-finished wall. Population few hundred.
locations.rationale: Last real settleent before wilderness. Three days (cells) east of Gamma-7. FX's safe house here.

locations.name: Site Gamma-7
locations.terrain: Rgged highlands. Surface buildings partially collapsed. Underground levels better preserved.
locations.rationale: 3 cells west of Stonefall = 3 days travel. Abandoned Flesh Architects research utpost. ViF coalition facility. Three Curves symbol throughout.

locations.name: Priary Facility (Flesh Architects)
locations.terrain: Deper into frotier wilderness. Active, operational installation. Defenses unknown.
locations.rationale: East-southeast of Gamma-7 (~2 cells). Main Flesh Architects installation. Houses Catalyst Project & Project Genesis. Zan escaped from here at age 13. Larger and more important than Gamma-7.

locations.name: Standig Stones
locations.terrain: Ridge-top. Nine moss-covered stones in a circle. Ancient funerary rite site. Pre-dates all known religions.
locations.rationale: Between Stonefall and Gamma-7 (~1 cell west of Stonefall). Ley line convergence point. Landmark on FX's map. Party visited in Session 3.

locations.name: Fanghold
locations.terrain: Cared into a mountain face overlooking the Icefang Sea. Single massive structure of stone, timber, and ice. Interconnected halls and chambers.
locations.rationale: Main Skallfang Cln settlement. Entire clan (~400 souls) lives within. One entrance — the Ice Gate.

locations.name: Icerst
locations.terrain: Smll fishing outpost on Icefang Sea coast. 20-30 clan members.
locations.rationale: One of three coastal Skallfang villages.

locations.name: Salfang
locations.terrain: Smll fishing outpost on Icefang Sea coast. 20-30 clan members.
locations.rationale: One of three coastal Skallfang villages.

locations.name: Nordrift
locations.terrain: Small fishing outpost on Icefang Sea coast. 20-30 clan members.
locations.rationale: One of three coastal Skallfang villages.

locations.name: Frostwood Staton
locations.terrain: Single longhouse with stable, smokehouse, and storage cellar. In the Frostwood forest.
locations.rationale: Hunting outpost used by Skallfang huners on extended expeditions. In Frostwood river valleys.

locations.name: Whspering Glacier
locations.terrain: Anient glacier that emits a constant low hum — 'the Whisper.' Deep within, a vault once held Khar'zul's sealed blade.
locations.rationale: Heart of the Frostmaw. Khar'zul's blade held here for first century of clan guardianship. Cold supressed the blade's inluence. Skallfang elders claim the glacier 'speaks'.

locations.name: Bonefields
locations.terrain: Vast stretch of frozen tundra littered with monster skeletons. Nothing grows. Burial chamers beneath.
locations.rationale: Between Fanghold and Icefang Sea. Generations of slain monsters + Skallfang ancestors buried together. Sound of howling dead beasts in deep winter.

locations.name: The Southeastern Port
locations.terrain: Heavily fortified port city. Built on ruins of pre-invasion city. Deep-water dock and lighthouse are pre-invasion originals.
locations.rationale: Sutheast coast. Major sea trade hub. Highly defensible by natural position. Exports: fruits, spices, timber, herbs.

locations.name: The Eatern Port
locations.terrain: Port settlement. Key waypoint on Eastern Sea Route.
locations.rationale: East coast. Handles significant maritime trade volume. Last to fall during invasion, first reclaimed.

locations.name: Elarwyn
locations.terrain: Deep within Verdant Reaches. Protected by magical barrier that shifts paths and disorients intruders.
locations.rationale: Aurora's birthplace. Founded by druids as refuge. Magical barrier keeps it hidden. Undiscovered by outside powers. Skylight cave nearby (ley line convergence).

locations.name: Cvern of Dicovery
locations.terrain: Rnote mountain cavern. Single large chamber with natural stone pillars. Underground stream (glacial metwater). Profound stillness.
locations.rationale: Mountain range near Nyra's childhood home, near Verdant Reaches area. Elemental air energy convergence. Site of Nyra's Air Elemental battle and first elemental crystal.

locations.name: The Black Willow
locations.terrain: Colossal tree of impossible proportions at center of Underdark forest. Trunk wide enough for carved chambers. Roots run throughout the forest. Canopy blocks all sunlight.
locations.rationale: Gows upon a ley line convergence. B's lingering consciousness caused unnatural growth. Crystal cave at roots (underground — not mapped). Eternal twilight beneath. Lolth claimed credit.

locations.name: The Azre Boneyard
locations.terrain: Dee cave in mountain range near Underdark. Lined with blue arcane-reactive crystals. Complete blue dragon skeleton at center.
locations.rationale: Acessible through mountain passages. Site of Kaelyn's transformation (crystal heart, draconic sorcery). Dragon drawn here by B-influence — same hoarding instinct. Crystals emit faint resonance detectable by B-touched.
